tools.prompt: Create a 16-second cinematic advertisement about a florist opening a small neighbourhood flower shop at dawn, widescreen 16:9. Photorealistic, warm natural dawn light, intimate neighbourly mood, realistic linen, paper and petal textures. Seven coherent shots with natural edits, the same florist, shop and flowers throughout. 0–2 seconds: tight medium shot below the lintel, a florist in a simple linen apron opens the wood-and-glass entrance door, golden light across the threshold, gentle camera push inward. 2–4 seconds: interior medium close-up, the linen-aproned florist gathers bright flower stems into one hand, fresh flower buckets beside a modest worktable, steady camera with shallow depth of field. 4–6 seconds: close-up, the florist with rolled linen sleeves places one pale blossom among the gathered bright flowers, worn tabletop beneath the stems, slow camera push closer. 6–8 seconds: overhead close-up, the linen-aproned florist folds kraft paper around the arrangement, a clear patch of worktable beneath the bouquet, locked overhead camera. 8–10 seconds: medium shot toward the open entrance, a customer in a light jacket arrives at the doorway, quiet dawn street beyond, gentle lateral camera slide. 10–14 seconds: medium two-shot, the light-jacketed customer with a broad genuine smile receives the finished paper-wrapped bouquet from the florist, flower buckets beside the doorway, steady eye-level camera. 14–16 seconds: static wide storefront portrait, the small shop with its welcoming open entrance and doorway flowers has a clear sign reading exactly 'Petal & Stem', soft dawn light across the facade, locked frontal camera. Hold this still, readable storefront image for the final two seconds. Gentle golden colour grade, calm uplifting pacing. No subtitles, no text overlays, no voiceover.

story.place: Petal & Stem, a small neighbourhood flower shop
story.prose: At dawn, a florist wearing a simple linen apron opens Petal & Stem, a small neighbourhood flower shop. The street is still quiet, and warm, natural light touches the doorway as the florist welcomes the new day. Inside, fresh flowers stand in buckets beside a modest worktable. The florist gathers a handful of stems, settles a pale blossom among brighter flowers, and folds paper around the bouquet with practiced care. The arrangement feels personal and freshly made, an everyday gift prepared by someone who knows their craft. A customer in a light jacket arrives at the open door. The florist offers the finished bouquet, and the customer accepts it with a broad, genuine smile. Their brief exchange gives the morning a friendly, neighbourly warmth. The moment ends on the shop front, its Petal & Stem sign readable above the welcoming entrance, with flowers gathered around the doorway in the soft dawn light.

Smiling customer wearing a light jacket
